name: Bitcoin
day_summary: Bitcoin fell −5.35% to ~$60,100 as Friday's risk-off bled into the weekend and the US-Iran escalation removed the one relief valve (lower oil). Shorts and puts paid for a third straight session; every bounce was sold.

decision.rationale: Momentum and macro both pointed down with no support in sight. SELL/de-risk: trim into strength, raise cash, and wait for the liquidation cascade to exhaust before even thinking about a level-defined re-entry.

positioning.notable_flow: Liquidation cascade accelerated through $62K; vol spiked as spot support gave way.

what_traders_are_doing: Risk-off and forced selling; the US-Iran escalation killed the lower-oil relief trade and traders pressed shorts into a vacuum of bids.

news.label: Crypto extends its slide as the US-Iran conflict feeds inflation fear and delays Fed cuts; rumors of Strategy selling bitcoin pile on

outlook.short_term: Downtrend intact; no support until the high-$50Ks.
outlook.long_term: Bull case on hold until the rate/dollar regime turns.

bull_case: Approaching levels where extreme fear historically marks washouts.
bear_case: No bid, no floor, and a worsening macro/geopolitical backdrop.
Forced selling from ETFs and a corporate holder overwhelms demand.
